assay: URA5-RFLP (Meyer et al. 2003)
intended_target: VNI, VNII, VNIII, VNIV, VGI, VGII, VGIII, VGIV (all 8 major molecular types)
post_pcr: RFLP, double digest Sau96I (10 U/uL) + HhaI (20 U/uL), 3 h or overnight, 3% agarose 100 V 5 h. Meyer 2003 publishes NO fragment-size table: patterns assigned visually vs standard strains (VNI-VNIV, VGI-VGIV), citing 'Jackson et al., unpub. data'. Only numeric pattern located in open literature: VNIV reference CBS 10079 (WM 629) = ~115, 156, 186, 318 bp (Florek et al. 2019 Folia Microbiol, doi 10.1007/s12223-019-00699-y, PMID 30963417).
source_location: Meyer et al. 2003 EID 9(2):189-195, Methods, 'URA5 Gene RFLP' paragraph (inline in text, no primer table)
notes: Orotidine monophosphate pyrophosphorylase (URA5) gene. PCR: 94C 2 min; 35x (94C 45 s, 61C 1 min, 72C 2 min); 72C 10 min.

assay: PLB1-RFLP (Latouche et al. 2003)
intended_target: VNI, VNII, VNIII, VNIV, VGI, VGII, VGIII, VGIV (all 8 major molecular types)
post_pcr: RFLP. AvaI -> 8 profiles A1-A8 mapping 1:1 to molecular types: VNI=A1, VNII=A2, VNIII=A3, VNIV=A4, VGI=A5, VGII=A6, VGIII=A7, VGIV=A8. HindIII -> 5 profiles H1-H5: VNI=H1, VNII=H1, VNIII=H2, VNIV=H3, VGI=H4, VGII=H4, VGIII=H4, VGIV=H5. Separated on 3% agarose. NO fragment sizes in bp are published - profiles are gel images (Fig. 1A/1B) and labels only.
source_location: Latouche et al. 2003 AEM 69(4):2080-2086, Methods, 'DNA extraction and PCR of the PLB1 gene fragment' (inline); profile-to-type mapping from Table 1 + Results
notes: Phospholipase B (PLB1). Published spaced as 'TGA GCT TCA GGC GGA GAG AGG TTT GG'; spaces removed only. 26 nt. Designed from the serotype B sequence. PCR: 94C 3 min; 35x (94C 45 s, 62C 45 s, 72C 1 min); 72C 7 min.

source_location: Latouche et al. 2003 AEM 69(4):2080-2086, Methods, 'DNA extraction and PCR of the PLB1 gene fragment' (inline)
notes: DEGENERACY WARNING: published as 'AGG CT{G} GGT GGT GTT GTC GTC ACC' with position 6 (G) in BOLDFACE - the single mismatch position. Source states serotypes A and D have a cytosine at that locus and serotype C a thymidine; primer carries the serotype B base. 24 nt. Not degenerate as written; allow 1 mismatch at position 6 when auditing.
